entries.name: After Images
entries.summary: Generative ambient composer: REC writes a new piece with four layers, 30 sound engines, eleven rule-based sequencers, an ambient mixer and three visuals, and the next piece follows on round the circle of fifths.

entries.name: ANTHEM
entries.summary: Generative firmware for the FM-1 in which up to four Langton's-ant-style walkers paint a grid and sing the note of each cell, with time that can run backwards, wave terrain synthesis and a chord arpeggiator. Early; not…

entries.name: AutoJam FM-1
entries.summary: Improvising band for the FM-1: lead, bass, harmony and drums play on PLAY, and a few notes recorded on REC are answered on the next chords, in 14 styles with 125 melodic presets and 41 drum kits.

entries.name: BA-55

entries.name: Dino Band
entries.summary: Toddler looper built on Rainbow mode: six dinosaurs, each a sound and a two-bar loop, played on the keys and recorded by letting notes stick while the band plays, with a pixel-art screen where the dinos react.

entries.name: Drum Peter

entries.name: Echo Ludwig

entries.name: FM-1 Big Screen +/Minus
entries.summary: Logic, Ableton Live and FL Studio plug-in for macOS that shows the FM-1's screen, with Big Screen builds of Hortator and MNM-1 that send it and a host-clock sync button; the README is in French.

entries.name: FM-1 Loop Station
entries.summary: Boss-style three-track loop station that runs in a browser on a phone or computer, with the FM-1 running FM1 Sampler as its controller, second screen and audio output.

entries.name: FM1 Orchestral Engine

entries.name: FMB Vocal
entries.summary: Physically modelled singing voice for the FM-1, a variation of FM-1 Chimera Vocal with a Bestiary that adds a dubstep robot, a babbling squid and a cat, a beatbox sequencer and a melody page. Pre-release.

entries.name: GigBox (FM-1 Fleet Manager)
entries.summary: Raspberry Pi touchscreen box, also served to a phone, that installs community firmware on several FM-1s by flash id, backs each unit up before writing, and can route USB MIDI between them.

entries.name: HYPNOTIC MIKE
entries.summary: Eight-track arranger for hypnotic, looping techno on M-VAVE's FM1 Open code, with an ARRANGE page of four knob modes (euclidean hits, mutate, swing, dub throw) and a two-tone green phone-style screen.

entries.name: Looching 2026
entries.summary: Revival of Brad Garton's 1991 NeXT drone generator Looching: four slow wavetable voices on a lazy random scheduler, five tone rows, and a mode that keeps the original program's quirks.

entries.summary: FM-1 firmware with sixteen Modular Town sounds on the pads, an arpeggiator that follows the DAW's MIDI clock, a gliding echo, a tape for sketches and an animated companion on the screen. Beta.

entries.name: Timer Tom

entries.name: HyperRig

entries.name: BrickPad
entries.summary: Source-visible sampler, synth and clip sequencer for the TrimUI Brick on Knulli, with twelve pads, sixteen scenes, four sound engines, effects and MIDI, played from the d-pad and buttons. Beta.
